versions.changelog:
# 把这个变成了小米官方提供的版本，若要用旧版或不熟悉的，可以回滚以前的版本！/This has been changed to the version provided by Xiaomi official. If you want to use the old version or are not familiar with it, you can roll back to a previous version!
**Summary:** Refactored skill for MiMo V2.5 TTS; now supports clearer modularity and documentation.

- Renamed from "mimo-tts-wav" to "mimo-v2-5-tts" with updated, more descriptive README.
- Added three focused scripts: mimo_tts.py, mimo_tts_voiceclone.py, mimo_tts_voicedesign.py, plus Feishu audio sending utility.
- Removed obsolete scripts and documentation, including example scripts and style guide.
- Documentation now covers model selection, advanced style and emotion control, director mode, and detailed usage guidance.
- Skill activation and scope clarified for broader voice synthesis, messaging, and narration needs.

-强调了音乐合成格式，防止严重跑调甚至糟糕的朗诵
-Emphasized the music synthesis format to prevent serious off-key singing or even poor recitation
-增加中英双语说明，国际友人更友好！
-Add bilingual Chinese-English instructions to be more friendly to international friends!
- Added broadcaster_test.log, output.wav, tts_broadcaster.py, tts_input.txt, and scripts/run_tts_wrapper.py to the repository.
- Included compiled Python cache: scripts/__pycache__/tts_simple.cpython-314.pyc.
- No changes to core functionality; these additions provide logging, example input/output, and script/broadcaster utilities.

- Initial release of mimo-tts-wav.
- Provides a tool for synthesizing text into WAV audio using Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-TTS models.
- Supports preset voices, voice design by text, and voice cloning.
- Integrates with OpenAI-compatible API, requiring MIMO_API_KEY.
- Includes scripts for single synthesis, style control, and streaming synthesis.
- Suitable for generating voice-overs, audiobooks, and voice messages.
